Do not infer Question-to-Block/KP mappings from title similarity, page proximity, System membership, source section, or model intuition.

Do not persist learner-specific full-paper holdout year values in shared Current; holdout is private browser-global learner state and every System sweep must respect the stored years.

Do not promote a LEARNING_ACCEPTANCE gate merely because CI/build is green, a page renders, a question bank is complete, or a file is labeled CURRENT.
Do not infer learner progress from this continuation file or from acceptance-status.json.
